ex.en: I was given a nice watch by my uncle.
ex.zh: 叔叔送了我一支漂亮的手錶。

ex.en: Mother gives my sister two thousand yen every month.
ex.zh: 媽媽每個月給妹妹兩千日圓。

give.en: to hand something to someone or let them have it

ex.en: She will give a presentation tomorrow.
ex.zh: 她明天要做簡報。

ex.en: Can you give me some advice?
ex.zh: 你可以給我一些建議嗎？

give.en: to provide something or to do something such as a talk

ex.en: I may give up soon and just nap instead.
ex.zh: 我可能很快就會放棄，乾脆去睡個午覺。

ex.en: Don't give up on your dream.
ex.zh: 不要放棄你的夢想。

give.en: to stop trying to do something

ex.en: I have to give back the book before Saturday.
ex.zh: 我必須在星期六前把書還回去。

ex.en: Please give back the keys before you leave.
ex.zh: 離開前請歸還鑰匙。

give.en: to return something to the person it belongs to

ex.en: The girl had a long scarf around her neck.
ex.zh: 那個女孩脖子上圍著一條長圍巾。

ex.en: There are more girls than boys in this school.
ex.zh: 這所學校女生比男生多。

ex.en: Meg was the only girl that was wearing jeans.
ex.zh: 梅格是唯一穿牛仔褲的女生。

girl.en: a female child or young woman

ex.en: Tom asked Mary to buy a gift for John.
ex.zh: 湯姆請瑪麗幫忙買一份禮物給約翰。

ex.en: Tom brings us gifts whenever he visits.
ex.zh: 湯姆每次來看我們都會帶禮物。

gift.en: something you give to someone without asking for money

ex.en: She has a gift for languages.
ex.zh: 她很有語言天分。

ex.en: He has a real gift for teaching.
ex.zh: 他真的很有教學天分。

gift.en: a natural ability to do something well

ex.en: No one gifted us anything.
ex.zh: 沒有人送我們任何東西。

ex.en: He gifted his old car to his nephew.
ex.zh: 他把舊車送給了姪子。

gift.en: to give something to someone as a present

ex.en: I've never seen such a giant watermelon!
ex.zh: 我從沒看過這麼大的西瓜！

ex.en: Seen from the sky, this river looks like a giant snake.
ex.zh: 從空中看，這條河像一條巨蛇。

ex.en: Apple is a tech giant.
ex.zh: 蘋果是科技巨頭。

ex.en: The retail giant plans to open fifty new stores.
ex.zh: 這家零售巨頭打算開五十家新店。

giant.en: an extremely large person, or a very large and powerful company

ex.en: The giraffe was walking along the river bank.
ex.zh: 長頸鹿沿著河岸走著。

ex.en: What sound does a giraffe make?
ex.zh: 長頸鹿是怎麼叫的？

ex.en: The kids loved feeding the giraffes at the zoo.
ex.zh: 孩子們很喜歡在動物園餵長頸鹿。

giraffe.en: a tall African animal with a very long neck

ex.en: At what age did you have your first girlfriend?
ex.zh: 你幾歲交了第一個女朋友？

ex.en: Tom took his girlfriend out on Saturday night.
ex.zh: 星期六晚上湯姆帶女朋友出去約會。

ex.en: Tom has had a lot of girlfriends.
ex.zh: 湯姆交過很多女朋友。

girlfriend.en: a woman or girl you are having a romantic relationship with

ex.en: Tom is really gifted.
ex.zh: 湯姆真有才華。

ex.en: Our school has a special program for gifted children.
ex.zh: 我們學校有專為資優兒童設計的課程。

gifted.en: having a natural ability to do something very well

ex.en: The video file is nearly two gigabytes in size.
ex.zh: 這個影片檔將近兩 GB。

ex.en: The tablet has 128 gigabytes of storage.
ex.zh: 這台平板有 128 GB 的儲存空間。

gigabyte.en: a unit for measuring computer data, equal to a billion bytes

ex.en: The store offered a reusable bag as a giveaway with each purchase.
ex.zh: 商店推出每筆消費贈送環保袋的活動。

ex.en: The logo on the package was a giveaway that it was a sample.
ex.zh: 包裝上的標誌明顯透露那是樣品。

giveaway.en: something that is given free, or something that shows the truth by accident

ex.en: Gift wrap is available at the service counter.
ex.zh: 服務櫃檯提供禮品包裝。

ex.en: She asked the cashier to gift wrap the vase.
ex.zh: 她請收銀員把花瓶包裝成禮物。

ex.en: She has given me a lot of useful advice.
ex.zh: 她給了我很多有用的建議。

ex.en: The prize was given to the student with the highest score.
ex.zh: 獎品頒給了分數最高的學生。

ex.en: At any given time, about a hundred people are in the hall.
ex.zh: 在任何特定的時刻，大廳裡大約有一百個人。

ex.en: Each student has a given amount of time to speak.
ex.zh: 每位學生有既定的發言時間。

ex.en: Given the heavy rain, the match was moved indoors.
ex.zh: 考慮到大雨，比賽改到室內舉行。

ex.en: He did well, given that he had little time to prepare.
ex.zh: 考慮到他準備的時間很少，他表現得不錯。

ex.en: The band has a gig at a small club on Friday.
ex.zh: 這個樂團星期五要在一間小俱樂部演出。

ex.en: We went to a jazz gig last night.
ex.zh: 我們昨晚去看了一場爵士樂演出。

ex.en: He took a weekend gig delivering food.
ex.zh: 他接了週末送餐的零工。

ex.en: She does freelance gigs to earn extra money.
ex.zh: 她接自由業的零工來賺外快。

ex.en: The little girls began to giggle during the lesson.
ex.zh: 小女孩們在上課時開始咯咯笑。

ex.en: He tried not to giggle at the teacher's funny hat.
ex.zh: 他努力忍住不笑出聲來，因為老師的帽子很好笑。

ex.en: She let out a small giggle and covered her mouth.
ex.zh: 她發出一聲輕笑，並用手摀住嘴。

ex.en: We heard a giggle from behind the door.
ex.zh: 我們聽到門後傳來咯咯的笑聲。

ex.en: A fish breathes through its gills.
ex.zh: 魚用鰓呼吸。

ex.en: The fisherman checked the gills to see if the fish was fresh.
ex.zh: 漁夫檢查魚鰓，看魚新不新鮮。

ex.en: Add some fresh ginger to the soup.
ex.zh: 在湯裡加一些新鮮的薑。

ex.en: Ginger tea helps me feel warm on a cold day.
ex.zh: 薑茶讓我在寒冷的日子裡覺得暖和。

ex.en: She chopped the ginger into thin slices.
ex.zh: 她把薑切成薄片。

ex.en: A gigantic wave rose above the small boat.
ex.zh: 一個巨浪高高聳立在小船上方。

ex.en: They live in a gigantic house with twenty rooms.
ex.zh: 他們住在一棟有二十個房間的巨大房子裡。

ex.en: The mirror had a heavy gilt frame.
ex.zh: 這面鏡子有個厚重的鍍金框。

ex.en: They sat in gilt chairs in the grand hall.
ex.zh: 他們坐在大廳裡鍍金的椅子上。

ex.en: He ordered a gin and tonic at the bar.
ex.zh: 他在酒吧點了一杯琴通寧。

ex.en: Gin is flavored with juniper berries.
ex.zh: 琴酒是用杜松子調味的。

gibraltar.zh: （地名）直布羅陀，位於伊比利半島南端

ex.en: Gibraltar sits at the southern tip of Spain.
ex.zh: 直布羅陀位於西班牙南端。

ex.en: The Strait of Gibraltar connects the Atlantic Ocean and the Mediterranean Sea.
ex.zh: 直布羅陀海峽連接大西洋和地中海。

ex.en: I felt giddy after spinning around too many times.
ex.zh: 轉了太多圈之後我覺得頭暈。

ex.en: Looking down from the tall tower made her giddy.
ex.zh: 從高塔往下看讓她頭暈目眩。

ex.en: The children were giddy with excitement on the last day of school.
ex.zh: 孩子們在學期最後一天興奮得飄飄然。

ex.en: She felt giddy when she heard the good news.
ex.zh: 聽到好消息時，她開心得暈陶陶的。

ex.en: He gingerly stepped onto the icy path.
ex.zh: 他小心翼翼地踏上結冰的小路。

ex.en: She gingerly touched the hot pan.
ex.zh: 她小心翼翼地碰了碰熱鍋子。

ex.en: The nurse gave the baby a gingerly pat on the back.
ex.zh: 護理師小心地輕拍寶寶的背。

ex.en: He took a gingerly step toward the edge.
ex.zh: 他小心翼翼地往邊緣走了一步。

ex.en: The palace had a gilded gate at the entrance.
ex.zh: 這座宮殿入口有一扇鍍金的大門。

ex.en: She kept the mirror in a gilded frame.
ex.zh: 她把鏡子放在鍍金的框裡。

ex.en: The free gift was just a gimmick to get people to buy more.
ex.zh: 那份贈品只是吸引人多買的噱頭。

ex.en: Some people say the talking fridge is a gimmick, not a real improvement.
ex.zh: 有些人說會說話的冰箱只是噱頭，不是真正的改進。

ex.en: She is a generous giver who donates to many charities.
ex.zh: 她是個慷慨的捐贈者，捐款給許多慈善機構。

ex.en: The giver of the gift left no name on the card.
ex.zh: 送禮的人沒在卡片上留下名字。

ex.en: She is giving her sister a birthday present.
ex.zh: 她正在送姊姊一份生日禮物。

ex.en: They are giving us plenty of time to finish.
ex.zh: 他們給我們充裕的時間完成。

ex.en: Giving is better than receiving, my mother always says.
ex.zh: 我媽媽常說，給予比接受更好。

ex.en: The holiday season is a time of giving.
ex.zh: 假期是樂於付出的時節。

ex.en: I didn't catch every word, but I got the gist.
ex.zh: 我沒聽懂每個字，但抓到了大意。

ex.en: Can you give me the gist of the story?
ex.zh: 你可以跟我說說這個故事的大意嗎？

ex.en: We baked a gingerbread house for the holiday party.
ex.zh: 我們為假日派對烤了一間薑餅屋。

ex.en: The gingerbread smelled of cinnamon and warm spice.
ex.zh: 薑餅聞起來有肉桂和溫暖的香料味。

ex.en: He bought a new gizmo that opens cans automatically.
ex.zh: 他買了一個會自動開罐頭的新小玩意兒。

ex.en: My uncle loves any kitchen gizmo with lots of buttons.
ex.zh: 我叔叔喜歡任何按鈕很多的廚房小裝置。

ex.en: The tree has a girth of more than three meters.
ex.zh: 這棵樹的樹幹周長超過三公尺。

ex.en: He was a man of considerable girth.
ex.zh: 他是個腰圍相當粗的人。

ex.en: She let out a girlish laugh and covered her mouth.
ex.zh: 她發出少女般的笑聲，並用手摀住嘴。

ex.en: The room was decorated in soft, girlish colors.
ex.zh: 房間裝飾著柔和、少女風的色調。

ex.en: The warrior wore a leather girdle around his waist.
ex.zh: 那位戰士腰間繫著一條皮腰帶。

ex.en: A girdle of green hills surrounds the small town.
ex.zh: 一圈綠色的山丘環繞著這個小鎮。

ex.en: A wide river girdles the old city on three sides.
ex.zh: 一條寬闊的河流從三面環繞著這座老城。

ex.en: Tall walls girdled the castle and protected it for centuries.
ex.zh: 高牆圍繞著城堡，保護了它數百年。

ex.en: She drinks ginseng tea when she feels tired.
ex.zh: 她覺得疲倦時會喝人參茶。

ex.en: Korean ginseng is often used in chicken soup.
ex.zh: 韓國人參常被用來煮雞湯。

ex.en: Workers lifted a steel girder into place on the bridge.
ex.zh: 工人把一根鋼梁吊到橋上定位。

ex.en: The girder supports the weight of the roof.
ex.zh: 這根大梁撐住屋頂的重量。

ex.en: Don't give up now; you are so close to finishing.
ex.zh: 現在別放棄，你就快完成了。

ex.en: After three failed attempts, he decided to give up and ask for help.
ex.zh: 失敗三次之後，他決定放棄並尋求協助。

give up.en: to stop trying because something is too difficult

ex.en: My father finally gave up smoking last year.
ex.zh: 我爸爸去年終於戒菸了。

ex.en: She is trying to give up sugary drinks this month.
ex.zh: 她這個月正努力戒掉含糖飲料。

give up.en: to stop doing something that is a habit, especially a bad one

ex.en: He gave up his seat on the bus to an elderly woman.
ex.zh: 他在公車上把座位讓給一位年長的女士。

ex.en: She gave up her weekends to take care of her sick mother.
ex.zh: 她犧牲週末的時間照顧生病的母親。

give up.en: to let someone else have something, or to lose it for a good reason

ex.en: After hours of begging, his mother finally gave in.
ex.zh: 懇求了好幾個小時後，他媽媽終於讓步了。

ex.en: We should not give in to unfair demands.
ex.zh: 我們不該向不合理的要求屈服。

ex.en: I gave in and bought the kids some ice cream.
ex.zh: 我拗不過孩子，買了冰淇淋給他們。

give in.en: to stop fighting and agree to what someone else wants

ex.en: We gave away our old books to the library.
ex.zh: 我們把舊書送給了圖書館。

ex.en: The shop is giving away free cups this week.
ex.zh: 這家店本週免費贈送杯子。

give away.en: to give something to someone for free

ex.en: Her smile gave away the surprise.
ex.zh: 她的笑容洩露了驚喜。

ex.en: Don't give away the ending of the movie.
ex.zh: 別洩露電影的結局。

give away.en: to let a secret become known

ex.en: The team gave away the lead in the last minute.
ex.zh: 球隊在最後一分鐘丟掉了領先優勢。

ex.en: Don't give away a good chance like this.
ex.zh: 別放掉像這樣的好機會。

give away.en: to lose a chance by mistake

ex.en: Please give back my pen when you finish.
ex.zh: 用完請把我的筆還給我。

ex.en: He gave back the money he found on the street.
ex.zh: 他把在街上撿到的錢還了回去。

give back.en: to return something to its owner

ex.en: She wants to give back to the town that raised her.
ex.zh: 她想回饋養育她的小鎮。

ex.en: Many successful people give back by helping students.
ex.zh: 許多成功人士透過幫助學生來回饋社會。

give back.en: to do something good in return for what you received

ex.en: The old heater gives off a strange smell when it first turns on.
ex.zh: 那台舊暖氣剛開機時會發出一股怪味。

ex.en: Fireflies give off a soft glow on warm summer nights.
ex.zh: 螢火蟲在溫暖的夏夜會發出柔和的光。

ex.en: The campfire was giving off a lot of heat, so we moved back.
ex.zh: 營火散發出很多熱氣，所以我們往後退了些。

give off.en: to produce light, heat, a smell or a sound

ex.en: The teacher gave out the test papers at the start of class.
ex.zh: 老師在上課一開始就把考卷發下去。

ex.en: Volunteers are giving out free water at the finish line.
ex.zh: 志工正在終點線免費分發飲用水。

ex.en: They gave out small gifts to everyone who came to the party.
ex.zh: 他們發小禮物給每一位來參加派對的人。

give out.en: to hand something to each person in a group

ex.en: The company gave out a statement about the delay this morning.
ex.zh: 公司今天早上發表了一份關於延誤的聲明。

ex.en: The old speaker gave out a loud crackling noise.
ex.zh: 那個舊喇叭發出很大的劈啪聲。

ex.en: Officials gave out the final results late last night.
ex.zh: 官員昨晚很晚才公布最後結果。

give out.en: to make a sound or share information publicly

ex.en: Our food supplies gave out before we reached the village.
ex.zh: 我們還沒到村子，糧食就用完了。

ex.en: His legs gave out halfway up the steep hill.
ex.zh: 爬到陡坡一半時，他的雙腿就撐不住了。

ex.en: My patience finally gave out after an hour of waiting.
ex.zh: 等了一個小時後，我的耐心終於用完了。

give out.en: to be completely used up or to stop working from tiredness

ex.en: Can you give a hand with these boxes?
ex.zh: 你可以幫忙搬這些箱子嗎？

ex.en: My neighbor gave a hand when our car broke down.
ex.zh: 我們的車拋錨時，鄰居出手幫忙。

ex.en: Let me give a hand in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 讓我來廚房幫忙。

ex.en: Can you give a lift to my sister?
ex.zh: 你可以載我妹妹一程嗎？

ex.en: He gave a lift to a tired hiker.
ex.zh: 他讓一位疲累的登山客搭了便車。

ex.en: I can give a lift to anyone going downtown.
ex.zh: 要去市區的人我都可以順路載。

give a lift.en: take someone somewhere in your car

ex.en: She gave a presentation on climate change.
ex.zh: 她做了一場關於氣候變遷的簡報。

ex.en: I have to give a presentation tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 我明天早上要做簡報。

ex.en: Many people feel nervous when they give a presentation.
ex.zh: 很多人做簡報時會緊張。

give a presentation.en: talk to a group about a topic

ex.en: The mayor gave a speech at the opening.
ex.zh: 市長在開幕典禮上致詞。

ex.en: He was asked to give a speech at the wedding.
ex.zh: 他被請在婚禮上致詞。

ex.en: I get nervous when I give a speech.
ex.zh: 我發表演說時會緊張。

give a speech.en: make a formal talk to an audience

ex.en: She gave birth to a healthy baby girl.
ex.zh: 她生下一個健康的女娃娃。

ex.en: The cat gave birth to four kittens.
ex.zh: 那隻貓生了四隻小貓。

ex.en: She will give birth to her first child in May.
ex.zh: 她預計五月生下第一個孩子。

give birth to.en: have a baby come out of the body

ex.en: The new technology gave birth to many small businesses.
ex.zh: 這項新科技催生了許多小型企業。

ex.en: This small town gave birth to a famous music style.
ex.zh: 這座小鎮孕育出一種有名的音樂風格。

ex.en: Hard times can give birth to great ideas.
ex.zh: 艱困的時期可能催生出好點子。

ex.en: We should give credit to the whole team.
ex.zh: 我們應該肯定整個團隊的付出。

ex.en: She gave credit to her teacher for her success.
ex.zh: 她把成功歸功於她的老師。

ex.en: Give credit where credit is due.
ex.zh: 該給的肯定就要給。

give credit.en: say that someone deserves praise for something

ex.en: You must give notice before you leave the apartment.
ex.zh: 你搬離公寓前必須先通知房東。

ex.en: She gave notice at work and left a month later.
ex.zh: 她向公司提出離職通知，一個月後離開。

ex.en: The school will give notice of any changes.
ex.zh: 學校會通知任何變動。

give notice.en: tell someone officially that something will happen

ex.en: The hospital gives priority to emergency cases.
ex.zh: 醫院優先處理緊急病例。

ex.en: We should give priority to safety.
ex.zh: 我們應該把安全放在第一位。

ex.en: The city gave priority to bus lanes.
ex.zh: 市政府優先規劃了公車專用道。

give priority to.en: treat something as more important than others

ex.en: The rumor gave rise to a lot of worry.
ex.zh: 這個謠言引起了許多擔憂。

ex.en: Heavy rain can give rise to floods.
ex.zh: 大雨可能引發水災。

ex.en: His strange comment gave rise to a long debate.
ex.zh: 他奇怪的評論引起了一場長時間的爭論。

ex.en: Drivers must give way to buses here.
ex.zh: 駕駛人在這裡必須禮讓公車。

ex.en: After a long talk, he gave way and agreed.
ex.zh: 談了很久後，他讓步並同意了。

ex.en: Please give way to people who need seats.
ex.zh: 請讓位給需要座位的人。

give way.en: let others go first, or stop opposing

give or take.zh: 增減而無大變化、允許有小誤差

ex.en: The trip takes two hours, give or take ten minutes.
ex.zh: 這趟路程約兩小時，上下差十分鐘左右。

ex.en: There were about fifty guests, give or take a few.
ex.zh: 大約有五十位客人，多少差幾個。

give or take.en: used when a number is not exact
